title: Efficient High-order Mass-conserving and Energy-balancing Schemes for Schrödinger-Poisson Equations
summary: We study relaxation-based approaches for conserving mass and energy in the numerical solution of Schrödinger-Poisson (SP) type systems. Relaxation-based methods offer a general approach that can be applied as post-time step processing to achieve conservation with any time-stepping scheme. Here we study two types of relaxation techniques applied to implicit-explicit Runge-Kutta schemes, with Fourier collocation in space.
